question: district wise 2023 employed at 6 months over enrolled rate, worst first
gold_sql: SELECT district, ROUND(100.0 * employed_at_6_months / women_enrolled, 1) AS employment_percent FROM livelihoods WHERE year = 2023 ORDER BY employment_percent ASC, district
sql_duckdb: WITH base AS (SELECT district, women_enrolled, employed_at_6_months FROM livelihoods WHERE year = 2023) SELECT district, (employed_at_6_months * 100.0 / NULLIF(NULLIF(women_enrolled, 0), 0)) AS employed_at_6_months_rate FROM base ORDER BY employed_at_6_months_rate ASC NULLS FIRST

district wise 2023 employed at 6 months over enrolled rate, worst first
attempts.response:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    district,
    women_enrolled,
    employed_at_6_months
  FROM livelihoods
  WHERE year = 2023
)
SELECT
  district,
  (employed_at_6_months * 100.0 / NULLIF(women_enrolled, 0)) AS employed_at_6_months_rate
FROM base
ORDER BY employed_at_6_months_rate ASC;
